review.tagline: Agent-driven video production pipelines run from your AI coding assistant
review.summary: OpenMontage is a set of pipelines, tools and stage skills that let a coding assistant (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf, Codex) research, script, generate assets, edit and render a video. Rendering uses Remotion or HyperFrames plus FFmpeg. It works with no API keys using Piper TTS and free footage from Archive.org, NASA and Wikimedia, and adds paid image, video and voice providers when keys are set.
review.audience: Creators and developers producing videos through a coding assistant
strengths: Works with zero API keys: Piper TTS, free archival footage, Remotion/HyperFrames, FFmpeg
Many providers via optional keys: fal.ai, Atlas Cloud, Kling, Runway, ElevenLabs, Suno, Google
Backlot local board shows pipeline progress, costs, and a storyboard approval gate before render
Can start from a reference YouTube, TikTok or local video and give cost estimates first
weaknesses: Needs an external AI coding assistant to drive it; no standalone prompting UI
AGPL-3.0 license restricts closed-source network use
Setup needs Python 3.10+, Node.js 18+ and FFmpeg; no Docker image
Local video generation needs a GPU; VRAM requirements are not stated in the README
needs: Needs Python 3.10+, FFmpeg, Node.js 18+, AI coding assistant, Remotion, HyperFrames
Models: wan2.2-ti2v-5b, wan2.1, hunyuan-1.5, ltx2-local, cogvideo-5b
